note: Re-judged 2026-11-27 independently against RFC 5216 Section 2.1.3 (rfc/full/rfc5216.txt): "If the EAP server authenticates successfully, the peer MUST send an EAP-Response packet of EAP-Type=EAP-TLS, and no data." Both tagged units only added ServerIdentity="eap-tls-server" (and AllowedIdentities=["eap-tls-client"]). Positive still asserts bareEAPTLSResponse(peerSent[successAt-1]); negative still asserts a peer rejecting an untrusted server sends its fatal TLS alert rather than the bare no-data Response. Verdict stands: enforced.
